To find the day of the week 567 days after Saturday, 2009-09-19, I need to determine how many complete weeks fit into 567 days.

567 ÷ 7 = 81 remainder 0

Since 567 days equals exactly 81 complete weeks (with no remainder), adding 567 days to a Saturday brings us back to the same day of the week.

**Saturday**
